rationale: Substituting net cash for gross cash in the archive's strongest signal (LiquidKnowledgeValue, ls_talpha 4.695) is an economically defensible test of debt overhang versus raw liquidity, but it is a single-term swap on an already-tested construction and much of its variation will simply reload on the well-known low-leverage/cash-holdings tilt, so the incremental information content is modest.

This is a cosmetic smoothing variant of RDEnabledCostEfficiencyValue (DELTA→TREND on the identical COGS/revenue conditioner with an identical value leg), exactly the kind of parameter tweak the objective warns against rather than a substantively different mechanism.

Beyond being a one-variable respecification of PriorKnowledgeCashPayoffValue (oancf→ib+xrd), the change induces mechanical overlap because the same ib+xrd quantity now drives both legs — firms with rising pre-R&D earnings mechanically tend toward higher pre-R&D earnings yield — so the "interaction" partly double-counts a single earnings-growth effect already spanned by the profitability-change literature.

This is a direct recombination of two already-evaluated archive components (PayoutSupportedKnowledgeYield's dividend-plus-R&D yield leg and LiquidKnowledgeValue's che/knowledge-asset leg) with no new construct, and cash-rich high-payout firms are close to a plain quality/payout screen already spanned by prior tests.

Conditioning R&D-adjusted earnings yield on the stability of R&D-adjusted ROA is a coherent and internally consistent test that differs meaningfully from StableRDProgramValue (which stabilized R&D intensity, not profitability), though it sits close to the well-documented earnings-volatility/quality-value interaction and the 5-year VOL requirement will thin coverage.

The hypothesis claims to identify "productive" recognized intangibles, but sale/(sale+intan) is just a monotone transform of low intangible intensity that assigns the maximum score of 1.0 to the large mass of firms with zero or missing intan, producing severe rank ties and reducing the signal to a value × no-goodwill tilt already covered by GoodwillCleanBookValue and InternalKnowledgeBookValueQuality.
